name: Apache Fineract
description: Open source core banking platform for microfinance, savings, and loan management.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      FINERACT_HIKARI_DRIVER_SOURCE_CLASS_NAME: org.postgresql.Driver
      FINERACT_HIKARI_DS_URL: "jdbc:postgresql://{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/fineract"
      FINERACT_HIKARI_PASSWORD: {{env.FINERACT_HIKARI_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/fineract/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: fineract
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.FINERACT_HIKARI_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: fineract
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-community-app:
    image: openmf/community-app:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-community-app
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      FINERACT_SERVER_URL: "https://localhost:8110"
